actions.description: Amend policy wording for KYC-C09 to reduce the periodic KYC updation frequency for high-risk customers from two years to at least once in every year as required by RBI-KYC-MD clause 12(a).
actions.draft_text: Periodic KYC updation - High risk [KYC-C09]. Periodic updation of KYC shall be carried out at least once every year for High risk customers. Control owner: Head of KYC Operations. Frequency: Annual

actions.description: Establish a remediation process to clear the backlog of 312 overdue high-risk customer KYC records to meet the 365-day regulatory periodicity.
Update the KYC tracking system parameters and automated alerts to trigger annual review notifications for high-risk customers instead of biennial triggers.

rationale: Updating the policy and control parameters directly aligns our internal KYC cycle for high-risk customers with RBI-KYC-MD clause 12(a)'s one-year requirement. Implementing the process change and system adjustments ensures the current backlog of overdue records is cleared and automated alerts enforce the annual frequency going forward.
